Abstract
--------

Compounds or salts thereof are described that correspond to general formula (I) below:

[![Figure US20150190323A1-20150709-C00001](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/21/bb/52/eee88318cc4302/US20150190323A1-20150709-C00001.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/21/bb/52/eee88318cc4302/US20150190323A1-20150709-C00001.png)

Also described, are pharmaceutical and cosmetic compositions that include these compounds. Methods of using these compounds and compositions for the treatment of pathological conditions are also described.
